what: Under a title fixed at the center, a window photo .27× smaller rises and attaches behind the title, then grows to fill the screen over the following one-screen scroll. As it finishes growing, the overlay on the photo darkens (.3 dark) and the same title turns from ink-black to white — a view looking out at the sea from inside a room.

options.grow: Start and end of growing (screen, 0 when the section top edge touches the screen top), default .99,1.92
options.shade: Range where the curtain darkens (screen), default .99,2.34
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Title panel pinned to the screen (Hero height)
options.[data-fx-part=ink]: Initially shown title (dark ink on the background)
options.[data-fx-part=paper]: Same title (white text) that appears to change over the photo
